purpose: Provide one canonical answer for what Foundation expects to be deployed, what the runtime actually reports, and whether those states agree.

truthStates.aligned: A current expectation and observation exist and every pinned deployment field matches.
truthStates.drift: A current expectation and observation exist but at least one pinned deployment field differs.
truthStates.unknown: Foundation lacks either the service identity, expected state or observed state needed to make a deployment comparison.
